in_sanskrit.name: Ishani
in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of the World, Goddess of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess who is the ruler of the universe, the giver of all prosperity and wealth.

in_hindi.name: ईशानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: देवी (Goddess) जो जगत्कारिणी (ruler of the universe) होती है और शुभकामनादायिनी (giver of all prosperity and wealth) है.

in_tamil.name: ஈசாணி
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவை (Goddess) ஜங்கத்காரிணி (ruler of the universe) ஹோத்தும் ஶுபக்காமணாதாயினி (giver of all prosperity and wealth) ஹோத்தும்.

in_telugu.name: ైశాణి
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేవీ (Goddess) జగత్ఖారిణి (ruler of the universe) హోయింది శుభకామనాదాయిని (giver of all prosperity and wealth) హోయింది.

in_marathi.name: Eesani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eesani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eesani is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Isha’, meaning ‘Goddess’ or ‘Lady’. This name is often used to refer to the Goddess Parvati or Shiva’s consort.
